description: A small clear plastic tupperware container with a gray latch sits on a green cloth, with several pink marshmallow-like pieces inside. The left hand steadies the container as a left-hand object while the right hand presses and flips the gray latch upward, opening the lid to the right; then the right hand reaches into the open container, pinches a pink piece, lifts it out, and releases it onto the cloth beside the container.
